title: A Trip to the Supermarket
text:
Anna goes to the supermarket on Saturday. She needs bread, milk, eggs and apples. She has a shopping list in her hand. The supermarket is big and the shelves are full of food.

At the checkout, Anna pays with a card. The apples are cheap today, so she buys a big bag. After shopping, she walks home with her bags. The bags are heavy, but she does not mind.

questions.text: What day does Anna go to the supermarket?
How does Anna pay at the checkout?
Why does Anna have a shopping list?
options: She wants to remember what to buy
She wants to visit a friend
She wants to go to school

questions.text: What can we guess about Anna's shopping trip?
options: She spent money on food for her home

vocabulary.definition: a large shop that sells food and other goods
a written list of things you want to buy
the place in a shop where you pay for your goods

paragraph_translations: Анна йде в супермаркет у суботу. Їй потрібні хліб, молоко, яйця та яблука. У руці в неї список покупок. Супермаркет великий, а полиці повні їжі.
На касі Анна платить карткою. Яблука сьогодні дешеві, тому вона купує великий пакет. Після покупок вона йде додому з сумками. Сумки важкі, але вона не проти.
